class.name: geo_tuner/ControllerHealthPanel
class.description: Geometric controller health at a glance: stream rates and staleness, hold/timeout failsafes, tracking errors, throttle and thrust-map health, and the active gains as wn/zeta. Read-only.

class.name: geo_tuner/TrajectoryTestPanel
class.description: Remote control for trajectory_test_node: pick setpoint / circle / lemniscate, set speed, start and stop. All safety gating stays in the node.

class.name: geo_tuner/GainPanel
class.description: Read and change the geometric controller gains as wn/zeta, behind an interlock, with design caps, a bounded step size, revert/restore, and a Save-to-vehicle button that persists them via gain_saver.

class.name: geo_tuner/TunerPanel
class.description: Run a geo_tuner auto-tuning session: start, watch the ladder progress, accept the result, abort. Sets the step envelope (lateral, vertical and yaw amplitudes) in flight, so the manoeuvre can be trimmed to the space available. All tuning logic, and all validation of those amplitudes, stays in the conductor.

class.name: geo_tuner/GeoFieldPanel
class.description: All four field panels as tabs in one dock: Tuner, Health, Gains, Fly. Use this one unless you specifically want them docked separately.
